Name: Frogify
Description: Choose an enemy creature (not a fusion): Until the end of your next turn, it's a Frog with 1 ATK, 1 HP and no effects. Then it turns back, with the HP it had.

Name: Spellbook
Description:
At the end of your turn: If your Spellcount is 3 or more, draw 1 card.

(Spellcount: the number of spells you've played this turn. A spell counts itself.)

Name: Community College of Magic
Description: Whenever a player plays their 3rd spell in a turn: They draw 1 card. (This affects both players.)
